mechanism: Both drugs can cause hypotension and bradycardia through different mechanisms; captopril via ACE inhibition and brimonidine via alpha-2 adrenergic agonism, with additive cardiovascular effects possible especially with systemic absorption of ophthalmic brimonidine.
action: Monitor blood pressure and heart rate regularly; counsel patient on proper ophthalmic instillation technique to minimize systemic absorption; assess for dizziness, syncope, or fatigue; adjust captopril dose if needed.
